database.format: JSON structure for portfolio and settings

api_endpoints.purpose: Fetch real-time stock prices and indicators (RSI, BB, EMA200).
Fetch OHLCV historical data (Candlesticks) for Price Action analysis.
Push proactive alerts to user's phone

business_rules: Prices are stored as Full Prices (e.g. 11500) but displayed as Divided Prices (/1000 = 11.5) for VN market.
Proactive alerts check every 10 minutes (via alarms).
T0 rule: Mini-trade profits are deducted from original entry price.
Swing trading recommendations must have a minimum Risk/Reward ratio of 1:2.
Theme persists across sessions via chrome.storage.local.theme.
features: Floating AI Widget across all websites
Telegram Alerts (Stop Loss, Take Profit, RSI Oversold)
Stock Scanner & AI Swing Recommendation (Historical Data Analysis)
Multi-Theme Support: Default, Cyber Pulse (Neon), Crystal Glass (Glassmorphism)

patterns: ES Modules in content script using dynamic import loader (content-loader.js).
Shadow DOM used for floating widget to encapsulate CSS.
Event Delegation in ui.js to manage large lists efficiently.
Theme Engine using CSS Variables and body.theme-* class selectors.
gotchas: Cannot use fetch() to TradingView directly in content.js due to CORS restrictions. Must proxy via background.js using chrome.runtime.sendMessage.
Download anchors must be appended to document.body (not ShadowRoot) to trigger download behavior in all browsers.
conventions: Use getDivisor() to dynamically adjust price displays without mutating underlying storage.
Minimize impact on stable modules by extending instead of modifying.
Export all reusable UI helpers (toggleModal, bindModalClose) to maintain module consistency.
